<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>For You</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500;1,600&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --ink-0:#0d0713;
    --ink-1:#170c22;
    --ink-2:#20122f;
    --rose:#ff7a9c;
    --rose-soft:#ffb4c6;
    --amber:#ffb457;
    --violet:#a78bfa;
    --cream:#f8ecdd;
    --muted:#cdb9d8;
    --line: rgba(248,236,221,0.14);
    --glass: rgba(248,236,221,0.05);
    --shadow-glow: 0 0 60px rgba(255,122,156,0.15);
    --ease: cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  }

  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}

  html{
    scroll-behavior:smooth;
  }

  body{
    background:var(--ink-0);
    color:var(--cream);
    font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
    font-weight:400;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    min-height:100vh;
    position:relative;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }

  ::selection{ background: var(--rose); color:var(--ink-0); }

  h1,h2,h3{ font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight:600; line-height:1.1; }
  .script{ font-family:'Caveat', cursive; }

  a, button { font-family: inherit; }

  #bg-canvas{
    position:fixed; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%;
    z-index:0; pointer-events:none;
  }

  .aurora{
    position:fixed; inset:-20%; z-index:0; pointer-events:none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(38% 30% at 18% 22%, rgba(167,139,250,0.20), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(45% 35% at 82% 18%, rgba(255,122,156,0.16), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(50% 40% at 50% 90%, rgba(255,180,87,0.10), transparent 60%);
    filter: blur(40px);
    animation: driftAurora 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes driftAurora{
    0%{ transform: translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1); }
    100%{ transform: translate3d(-2%,2%,0) scale(1.08); }
  }

  main{ position:relative; z-index:1; }

  section{
    position:relative;
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding: 8vh 6vw;
    text-align:center;
  }

  .eyebrow{
    font-size:0.72rem;
    letter-spacing:0.32em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--rose-soft);
    opacity:0.8;
    margin-bottom:18px;
    font-weight:600;
  }

  .reveal{
    opacity:0; transform: translateY(28px);
    transition: opacity 0.9s var(--ease), transform 0.9s var(--ease);
  }
  .reveal.in-view{ opacity:1; transform:none; }
  .reveal.d1{ transition-delay:0.08s; }
  .reveal.d2{ transition-delay:0.18s; }
  .reveal.d3{ transition-delay:0.28s; }
  .reveal.d4{ transition-delay:0.38s; }

  /* ---------- editable affordances ---------- */
  [data-editable]{ outline-offset:6px; border-radius:6px; }
  body.edit-mode [data-editable]{
    cursor:text;
    outline: 1.5px dashed rgba(255,180,87,0.55);
    background: rgba(255,180,87,0.05);
  }
  body.edit-mode [data-editable]:focus{
    outline: 1.5px solid var(--amber);
    background: rgba(255,180,87,0.09);
  }

  /* ---------- top controls ---------- */
  #edit-toggle{
    position:fixed; top:18px; right:18px; z-index:50;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    background:rgba(13,7,19,0.6);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    color:var(--cream);
    padding:10px 16px 10px 12px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.01em;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: all 0.25s var(--ease);
  }
  #edit-toggle:hover{ border-color:var(--amber); transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }
  #edit-toggle .dot{ width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--rose); }
  body.edit-mode #edit-toggle .dot{ background:var(--amber); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--amber); }

  #hint{
    position:fixed; top:64px; right:18px; z-index:49;
    max-width:220px; font-size:0.78rem; line-height:1.4;
    color:var(--muted); background:rgba(13,7,19,0.7);
    border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px;
    padding:12px 14px; backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    transition: opacity 0.4s var(--ease), transform 0.4s var(--ease);
  }
  #hint.hidden{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(-6px); pointer-events:none; }

  /* progress dots */
  #dotnav{
    position:fixed; left:18px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%);
    z-index:40; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px;
  }
  #dotnav button{
    width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(248,236,221,0.22);
    border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:0;
    transition: all 0.3s var(--ease);
  }
  #dotnav button.active{ background:var(--rose); box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--rose); transform:scale(1.35); }
  @media (max-width:720px){ #dotnav{ display:none; } }

  /* ---------- envelope icon ---------- */
  #envelope{ min-height:100svh; }
  .seal-wrap{
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:30px;
  }
  .mailbox-wrap{
    width:min(300px, 78vw);
    cursor:pointer;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4));
    animation: mailboxIdle 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease);
  }
  .mailbox-wrap:hover{ transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.015); }
  #envelope.opened .mailbox-wrap{ animation: none; }
  @keyframes mailboxIdle{
    0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0); }
    50%{ transform: translateY(-6px); }
  }

  .mail-card{
    transform-origin: center bottom;
    transform: translateY(0);
    transition: transform 0.85s var(--ease);
  }
  #envelope.opened .mail-card{ transform: translateY(-16px) scale(1.03); }

  .mail-flap{
    transform-origin: 150px 150px;
    transition: transform 0.7s var(--ease) 0.1s, opacity 0.7s var(--ease) 0.1s;
  }
  #envelope.opened .mail-flap{ transform: scaleY(0.86); opacity:0.85; }

  .mail-back{
    transition: transform 0.7s var(--ease);
    transform-origin: 150px 70px;
  }
  #envelope.opened .mail-back{ transform: translateY(-4px); }

  .open-label{
    font-size:0.82rem; letter-spacing:0.24em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--muted); font-weight:600;
  }
  #envelope.opened .open-label{ opacity:0; }

  .env-caption{ margin-top:26px; }
  .env-caption .to{ font-size:1.6rem; color:var(--rose-soft); }
  .env-caption .from{ margin-top:6px; font-size:1rem; color:var(--muted); }

  .scroll-cue{
    position:absolute; bottom:34px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
    font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.3em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--muted); opacity:0.7;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  }
  .scroll-cue .line{ width:1px; height:34px; background:linear-gradient(var(--rose), transparent); animation: pulseLine 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes pulseLine{ 0%,100%{opacity:.3} 50%{opacity:1} }

  /* ---------- hero ---------- */
  #hero .kicker{ font-size:1rem; color:var(--rose-soft); margin-bottom:10px; }
  #hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(2.6rem, 8vw, 5.6rem);
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--cream) 20%, var(--rose-soft) 50%, var(--amber) 80%);
    -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
    padding: 0 4px;
  }
  #hero .sub{ margin-top:22px; max-width:560px; font-size:1.08rem; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; }
  .glow-orb{
    position:absolute; width:340px; height:340px; border-radius:50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,122,156,0.25), transparent 70%);
    filter: blur(10px); top:10%; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
    z-index:-1; animation: breathe 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes breathe{ 0%,100%{ opacity:.6; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1);} 50%{ opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1.15);} }

  /* ---------- reasons ---------- */
  #reasons{ align-items:stretch; }
  .section-head{ max-width:640px; margin: 0 auto 56px; }
  .section-head h2{ font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4.4vw,2.8rem); }
  .section-head p{ margin-top:12px; color:var(--muted); font-size:1rem; }

  .reasons-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:20px;
    max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; width:100%;
  }
  @media (max-width:680px){ .reasons-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  .reason-card{
    background:var(--glass);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:18px;
    padding:26px 24px;
    text-align:left;
    position:relative;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    transition: transform 0.4s var(--ease), border-color 0.4s var(--ease), background 0.4s var(--ease);
  }
  .reason-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: rgba(255,122,156,0.4); background: rgba(255,122,156,0.06); }
  .reason-mark{
    font-family:'Caveat', cursive; font-size:1.7rem; color:var(--amber);
    display:block; margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .reason-card p{ font-size:1.02rem; line-height:1.55; color:var(--cream); }

  /* ---------- gallery ---------- */
  .polaroid-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, minmax(140px,1fr));
    gap:26px 22px; max-width:920px; width:100%; margin:0 auto;
  }
  @media (max-width:680px){ .polaroid-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); } }

  .polaroid-grid--single{
    grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 320px);
    justify-content:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:680px){ .polaroid-grid--single{ grid-template-columns: minmax(200px, 280px); } }

  .polaroid{
    background:#f4ede1; border-radius:6px; padding:10px 10px 30px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    transform: rotate(var(--r,-2deg));
    transition: transform 0.35s var(--ease);
    position:relative;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .polaroid:nth-child(2n){ --r:2deg; }
  .polaroid:nth-child(3n){ --r:-3deg; }
  .polaroid:nth-child(4n){ --r:1.5deg; }
  .polaroid:hover{ transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.04); z-index:5; }
  .polaroid .frame{
    aspect-ratio:1/1; border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg,#2a1a38,#180d24);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    color:#c9b8d6; font-size:0.78rem; text-align:center; padding:10px;
  }
  .polaroid .frame img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  .polaroid .tape{
    position:absolute; top:-10px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-2deg);
    width:56px; height:20px;
    background: rgba(255,229,180,0.55);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  }
  .polaroid figcaption{
    margin-top:8px; text-align:center; font-family:'Caveat',cursive;
    font-size:1.05rem; color:#241531;
  }
  .polaroid input[type=file]{ display:none; }
  .upload-badge{
    position:absolute; bottom:34px; right:12px;
    background:var(--amber); color:#2a1508; width:26px; height:26px;
    border-radius:50%; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  body.edit-mode .upload-badge{ display:flex; }

  /* ---------- candle / wish ---------- */
  #candle{ min-height:100svh; }
  .candle-stage{ position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; }
  .cake-img{
    width:min(260px, 62vw);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.45));
    animation: cakeFloat 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: transform 0.35s var(--ease);
    user-select:none; -webkit-user-drag:none;
  }
  .cake-img:hover{ transform: scale(1.03); }
  @keyframes cakeFloat{
    0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0); }
    50%{ transform: translateY(-8px); }
  }
  .candle-stage.blown .cake-img{
    animation: cakePop 0.6s var(--ease);
  }
  @keyframes cakePop{
    0%{ transform: scale(1); }
    35%{ transform: scale(0.94) rotate(-1.5deg); }
    65%{ transform: scale(1.06) rotate(1.5deg); }
    100%{ transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
  }
  .sparkle{
    position:absolute; font-size:1.1rem; opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
    transform: scale(0.4);
    transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease), transform 0.6s var(--ease);
  }
  .candle-stage.blown .sparkle{ opacity:1; transform: scale(1) translateY(-14px); }
  .sparkle.s1{ top:6%; left:14%; transition-delay:0.05s; }
  .sparkle.s2{ top:0%; right:14%; transition-delay:0.15s; }
  .sparkle.s3{ top:30%; left:2%; transition-delay:0.25s; }
  .sparkle.s4{ top:26%; right:0%; transition-delay:0.1s; }
  .candle-hint{ margin-top:26px; font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:0.04em; }

  .wish-note{
    margin-top:34px; max-width:420px;
    opacity:0; transform: translateY(16px);
    transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease), transform 0.7s var(--ease);
  }
  .wish-note.shown{ opacity:1; transform:none; }
  .wish-note p{ font-family:'Caveat', cursive; font-size:1.5rem; color:var(--rose-soft); line-height:1.4; }

  #confetti-canvas{ position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:60; pointer-events:none; }

  /* ---------- letter ---------- */
  #letter{ padding-bottom:14vh; }
  .letter-card{
    max-width:620px; width:100%;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(248,236,221,0.06), rgba(248,236,221,0.02));
    border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:22px;
    padding: 48px 40px; text-align:left;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
  }
  .letter-card .greet{ font-family:'Caveat',cursive; font-size:2.1rem; color:var(--rose-soft); }
  .letter-card .body-text{ margin-top:18px; font-size:1.06rem; line-height:1.85; color:var(--cream); white-space:pre-wrap; }
  .letter-card .sign{ margin-top:26px; font-family:'Caveat',cursive; font-size:1.7rem; color:var(--amber); text-align:right; }

  .heart-btn{
    margin-top:44px;
    background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--rose), #ff9f7a);
    color:#2a0b17; border:none; padding:14px 22px 14px 30px; border-radius:999px;
    font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem; letter-spacing:0.02em; cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(255,122,156,0.35);
    transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.3s var(--ease);
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  }
  .heart-btn:hover{ transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(255,122,156,0.45); }
  .heart-bubble{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%;
    background: rgba(255,214,232,0.95);
    font-size:1rem; line-height:1;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    animation: heartPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes heartPulse{
    0%{ transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
    14%{ transform:scale(1.28); box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(255,45,99,0.65); }
    28%{ transform:scale(0.98); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
    42%{ transform:scale(1.22); box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(255,45,99,0.65); }
    60%,100%{ transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
  }

  .credit{ margin-top:60px; font-size:0.72rem; color:rgba(205,185,216,0.5); letter-spacing:0.08em; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{ animation-duration:0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.2s !important; }
  }

  .lightbox{
    position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(8,4,12,0.9); z-index:70;
    display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:5vw;
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  }
  .lightbox.open{ display:flex; }
  .lightbox img{ max-width:min(720px,90vw); max-height:85vh; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
</style>
</head>
<body data-edit-mode="false">

<div class="aurora"></div>
<canvas id="bg-canvas"></canvas>
<canvas id="confetti-canvas"></canvas>

<button id="edit-toggle" type="button"><span class="dot"></span><span id="edit-toggle-label">Personalize</span></button>
<div id="hint">Tap <strong>Personalize</strong> to edit any text or tap a photo to upload your own — it all saves automatically.</div>

<nav id="dotnav" aria-label="Section navigation">
  <button data-target="envelope" class="active" aria-label="Go to envelope"></button>
  <button data-target="hero" aria-label="Go to intro"></button>
  <button data-target="reasons" aria-label="Go to reasons"></button>
  <button data-target="gallery" aria-label="Go to memories"></button>
  <button data-target="candle" aria-label="Go to wish"></button>
  <button data-target="letter" aria-label="Go to letter"></button>
</nav>

<main>

  <section id="envelope">
    <div class="seal-wrap">
      <div class="mailbox-wrap" id="seal-btn" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Open the envelope">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 300 240" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="cardShine" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
              <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
              <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fff2f7"/>
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>

          <!-- back mountain flap peeking above -->
          <path class="mail-back" d="M150,18 L205,78 L95,78 Z" fill="#ffd6e8"/>

          <!-- card peeking out -->
          <g class="mail-card">
            <rect x="76" y="44" width="148" height="110" rx="10" fill="url(#cardShine)" stroke="#f3c9dc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <circle cx="196" cy="70" r="13" fill="#ff8fbc"/>
            <rect x="98" y="66" width="48" height="8" rx="4" fill="#f6d7e6"/>
            <rect x="98" y="88" width="86" height="8" rx="4" fill="#f6d7e6"/>
            <rect x="98" y="106" width="66" height="8" rx="4" fill="#f6d7e6"/>
          </g>

          <!-- envelope body -->
          <path d="M46,110 H254 A10,10 0 0 1 264,120 V206 A10,10 0 0 1 254,216 H46 A10,10 0 0 1 36,206 V120 A10,10 0 0 1 46,110 Z"
                fill="#ffc2dc" stroke="#e88bb0" stroke-width="2"/>

          <!-- side shading panels -->
          <path d="M36,120 L150,190 L36,206 Z" fill="#ffb0d1" opacity="0.9"/>
          <path d="M264,120 L150,190 L264,206 Z" fill="#ffcfe3" opacity="0.9"/>

          <!-- front flap -->
          <path class="mail-flap" d="M36,206 L150,140 L264,206 A10,10 0 0 1 254,216 H46 A10,10 0 0 1 36,206 Z" fill="#ffa8cc"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="env-caption">
        <div class="to script" data-editable data-key="env-to">To My Favorite Person</div>
        <div class="from" data-editable data-key="env-from">— from someone who's glad you exist</div>
      </div>
      <div class="open-label">tap the envelope</div>
    </div>
    <div class="scroll-cue"><span>scroll</span><span class="line"></span></div>
  </section>

  <section id="hero">
    <div class="glow-orb"></div>
    <div class="reveal">
      <p class="kicker eyebrow" data-editable data-key="hero-kicker">Happy Birthday</p>
      <h1 data-editable data-key="hero-name">Her Name</h1>
      <p class="sub" data-editable data-key="hero-sub">Every year I get to know you feels like the best one yet. Today's entirely about you — so I made you this, just because you deserve it.</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="reasons">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">A Few Things</p>
      <h2 data-editable data-key="reasons-title">Reasons I adore you</h2>
      <p data-editable data-key="reasons-sub">Not all of them — just the ones that came to mind first.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="reasons-grid">
      <div class="reason-card reveal d1"><span class="reason-mark">✧</span><p data-editable data-key="reason-1">The way you laugh at your own jokes before you even finish telling them.</p></div>
      <div class="reason-card reveal d2"><span class="reason-mark">✧</span><p data-editable data-key="reason-2">How you remember tiny details about people and make them feel so seen.</p></div>
      <div class="reason-card reveal d3"><span class="reason-mark">✧</span><p data-editable data-key="reason-3">The way a room feels warmer the second you walk into it.</p></div>
      <div class="reason-card reveal d4"><span class="reason-mark">✧</span><p data-editable data-key="reason-4">That you're somehow this thoughtful and this fun at the same time.</p></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="gallery">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">Little Memories</p>
      <h2 data-editable data-key="gallery-title">Moments worth keeping</h2>
      <p data-editable data-key="gallery-sub">Tap "Personalize" to swap these in for your own photos of us.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="polaroid-grid polaroid-grid--single">
      <figure class="polaroid reveal d1" data-photo="p1">
        <div class="tape"></div>
        <div class="frame"><span class="ph-text">+ Add a photo</span><img alt="" style="display:none;"></div>
        <div class="upload-badge">＋</div>
        <input type="file" accept="image/*">
        <figcaption contenteditable="false" data-editable data-key="cap-1">that one day</figcaption>
      </figure>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="candle">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">One More Thing</p>
      <h2 data-editable data-key="candle-title">Make a wish</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="candle-stage reveal" id="candle-stage">
      <span class="sparkle s1">✨</span>
      <span class="sparkle s2">🎉</span>
      <span class="sparkle s3">💫</span>
      <span class="sparkle s4">✨</span>
      <img class="cake-img" id="cake-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="A three-tier birthday cake with candles" draggable="false">
      <p class="candle-hint" id="candle-hint">tap the cake to make a wish</p>
      <div class="wish-note" id="wish-note">
        <p data-editable data-key="wish-text">Whatever you wished for — I hope it finds you. And if it didn't come true on its own, I'll happily help it along.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="letter">
    <div class="letter-card reveal">
      <p class="greet" data-editable data-key="letter-greet">Hey you,</p>
      <p class="body-text" data-editable data-key="letter-body">I know this is a little extra — but you deserve extra. I hope today feels as good as you make everyone around you feel. Thank you for being exactly who you are. Here's to another year of finding out just how lucky I am to know you.

Happy birthday.</p>
      <p class="sign" data-editable data-key="letter-sign">— always, me</p>
    </div>
    <button class="heart-btn" id="celebrate-btn" type="button">Celebrate <span class="heart-bubble">🩷</span></button>
    <p class="credit">made with care, just for you</p>
  </section>

</main>

<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox"><img id="lightbox-img" src="" alt=""></div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var STORAGE_KEY = "bday-site-state-v1";
  var reduced = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ---------- persistence ---------- */
  function loadState(){
    try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) || {}; }
    catch(e){ return {}; }
  }
  function saveState(state){
    try{ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); }
    catch(e){ /* storage full or unavailable — fail silently */ }
  }
  var state = loadState();
  state.texts = state.texts || {};
  state.photos = state.photos || {};

  function applySavedContent(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-editable]').forEach(function(el){
      var key = el.getAttribute('data-key');
      if(state.texts[key] !== undefined){ el.innerText = state.texts[key]; }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-photo]').forEach(function(fig){
      var key = fig.getAttribute('data-photo');
      var src = state.photos[key];
      if(src){
        var img = fig.querySelector('img');
        var ph = fig.querySelector('.ph-text');
        img.src = src; img.style.display = 'block';
        if(ph) ph.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });
  }
  applySavedContent();

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-editable]').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('input', function(){
      state.texts[el.getAttribute('data-key')] = el.innerText;
      saveState(state);
    });
    el.addEventListener('blur', function(){
      state.texts[el.getAttribute('data-key')] = el.innerText;
      saveState(state);
    });
  });

  /* ---------- edit mode ---------- */
  var body = document.body;
  var editBtn = document.getElementById('edit-toggle');
  var editLabel = document.getElementById('edit-toggle-label');
  var hint = document.getElementById('hint');

  function setEditMode(on){
    body.classList.toggle('edit-mode', on);
    body.setAttribute('data-edit-mode', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    editLabel.textContent = on ? 'Preview' : 'Personalize';
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-editable]').forEach(function(el){
      el.setAttribute('contenteditable', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }
  setEditMode(false);

  editBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var on = !body.classList.contains('edit-mode');
    setEditMode(on);
    hint.classList.add('hidden');
    try{ localStorage.setItem('bday-hint-dismissed','1'); }catch(e){}
  });

  if(localStorage.getItem && (function(){ try{return localStorage.getItem('bday-hint-dismissed');}catch(e){return null;} })()){
    hint.classList.add('hidden');
  }
  setTimeout(function(){ hint.classList.add('hidden'); }, 9000);

  /* ---------- photo upload / lightbox ---------- */
  var lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  var lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');

  document.querySelectorAll('.polaroid').forEach(function(fig){
    var input = fig.querySelector('input[type=file]');
    var img = fig.querySelector('img');
    var key = fig.getAttribute('data-photo');

    fig.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      if(body.classList.contains('edit-mode')){
        input.click();
      } else if(img.style.display !== 'none' && img.src){
        lightboxImg.src = img.src;
        lightbox.classList.add('open');
      }
    });

    input.addEventListener('change', function(){
      var file = input.files && input.files[0];
      if(!file) return;
      var reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(ev){
        img.src = ev.target.result;
        img.style.display = 'block';
        var ph = fig.querySelector('.ph-text');
        if(ph) ph.style.display = 'none';
        state.photos[key] = ev.target.result;
        saveState(state);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  });

  lightbox.addEventListener('click', function(){ lightbox.classList.remove('open'); });

  /* ---------- envelope ---------- */
  var envelope = document.getElementById('envelope');
  var sealBtn = document.getElementById('seal-btn');
  function openMailbox(){
    if(envelope.classList.contains('opened')) return;
    envelope.classList.add('opened');
    setTimeout(function(){
      document.getElementById('hero').scrollIntoView({behavior: reduced ? 'auto' : 'smooth'});
    }, 650);
  }
  sealBtn.addEventListener('click', openMailbox);
  sealBtn.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' '){ e.preventDefault(); openMailbox(); }
  });

  /* ---------- scroll reveal ---------- */
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if(entry.isIntersecting){ entry.target.classList.add('in-view'); }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.2 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });

  /* ---------- dot nav ---------- */
  var sections = ['envelope','hero','reasons','gallery','candle','letter'];
  var dots = document.querySelectorAll('#dotnav button');
  dots.forEach(function(dot){
    dot.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var el = document.getElementById(dot.getAttribute('data-target'));
      if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior: reduced ? 'auto':'smooth'});
    });
  });
  var navIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        var id = entry.target.id;
        dots.forEach(function(d){ d.classList.toggle('active', d.getAttribute('data-target') === id); });
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.5 });
  sections.forEach(function(id){
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if(el) navIO.observe(el);
  });

  /* ---------- candle ---------- */
  var candleStage = document.getElementById('candle-stage');
  var candleHint = document.getElementById('candle-hint');
  var wishNote = document.getElementById('wish-note');
  var blown = false;
  candleStage.addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(blown) return;
    blown = true;
    candleStage.classList.add('blown');
    candleHint.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(function(){
      wishNote.classList.add('shown');
      burstConfetti(window.innerWidth/2, window.innerHeight*0.45, 70);
    }, 500);
  });

  /* ---------- celebrate button ---------- */
  document.getElementById('celebrate-btn').addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var rect = e.target.getBoundingClientRect();
    burstConfetti(rect.left + rect.width/2, rect.top, 90);
  });

  /* ---------- confetti ---------- */
  var cc = document.getElementById('confetti-canvas');
  var cctx = cc.getContext('2d');
  var confettiParticles = [];
  var confettiRunning = false;
  var palette = ['#ff7a9c','#ffb457','#a78bfa','#f8ecdd','#ff9f7a'];

  function resizeCanvas(){
    cc.width = window.innerWidth; cc.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resizeCanvas();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

  function burstConfetti(x, y, count){
    if(reduced) return;
    for(var i=0;i<count;i++){
      confettiParticles.push({
        x: x, y: y,
        vx: (Math.random()-0.5) * 9,
        vy: Math.random() * -9 - 3,
        size: Math.random()*7 + 4,
        color: palette[Math.floor(Math.random()*palette.length)],
        rot: Math.random()*Math.PI*2,
        vr: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.3,
        life: 0,
        maxLife: 110 + Math.random()*40
      });
    }
    if(!confettiRunning){ confettiRunning = true; requestAnimationFrame(tickConfetti); }
  }

  function tickConfetti(){
    cctx.clearRect(0,0,cc.width,cc.height);
    var alive = [];
    for(var i=0;i<confettiParticles.length;i++){
      var p = confettiParticles[i];
      p.vy += 0.22;
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.rot += p.vr; p.life++;
      var fade = 1 - (p.life/p.maxLife);
      if(fade <= 0 || p.y > cc.height+30) continue;
      cctx.save();
      cctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(fade,0);
      cctx.translate(p.x,p.y);
      cctx.rotate(p.rot);
      cctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      cctx.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size/3,p.size,p.size*0.66);
      cctx.restore();
      alive.push(p);
    }
    confettiParticles = alive;
    if(confettiParticles.length > 0){
      requestAnimationFrame(tickConfetti);
    } else {
      confettiRunning = false;
      cctx.clearRect(0,0,cc.width,cc.height);
    }
  }

  /* ---------- ambient background particles ---------- */
  var bg = document.getElementById('bg-canvas');
  var bctx = bg.getContext('2d');
  var motes = [];
  var MOTE_COUNT = reduced ? 0 : 46;

  function resizeBg(){
    bg.width = window.innerWidth; bg.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resizeBg();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeBg);

  for(var m=0;m<MOTE_COUNT;m++){
    motes.push({
      x: Math.random()*window.innerWidth,
      y: Math.random()*window.innerHeight,
      r: Math.random()*1.8 + 0.6,
      s: Math.random()*0.35 + 0.08,
      drift: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
      hue: Math.random() > 0.5 ? '255,180,87' : '255,122,156',
      o: Math.random()*0.5 + 0.15
    });
  }

  function tickBg(){
    bctx.clearRect(0,0,bg.width,bg.height);
    for(var i=0;i<motes.length;i++){
      var mo = motes[i];
      mo.y -= mo.s;
      mo.x += mo.drift;
      if(mo.y < -10){ mo.y = bg.height + 10; mo.x = Math.random()*bg.width; }
      bctx.beginPath();
      bctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + mo.hue + ',' + mo.o + ')';
      bctx.arc(mo.x, mo.y, mo.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
      bctx.fill();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tickBg);
  }
  if(!reduced){ requestAnimationFrame(tickBg); }

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
